description: Lists the image IDs inside image group (DGS) 5834046, the part of Ayling's 'Revised register of the soldiers and sailors of New Hampshire in the War of the Rebellion, 1861-1866' (p. 434-881) that catalog entry olib:1880942, 'New Hampshire, Civil War records, 1861-1866', lists. Captured live 2026-11-27 with dev/try-image-search.ts 5834046. Drives ut_search_images_np2: a DGS taken from catalog_search's film notes has real page images, so the agent must not say none are digitized. The substring predicate matches both the bare '5834046' and the zero-padded '005834046'. 450 images.
